rules.note: round 0 review: every terrain/backdrop depth-step curtain (the canyon rims top right, the wedges behind the mid-ground mesas, the tails behind the dwellings) reads as hard directional streaks; blurred, the same curtains read as haze/shadowed rock. Removing them opens sky holes in the canyon floor, so fade, not remove.
